description.value: Ladurée is the iconic Parisian macaron brand operating a boutique and tea salon on downtown Vancouver's Robson Street shopping corridor. The space features Parisian-style tea rooms offering classic French dishes and an Afternoon Tea service, alongside a retail selection of macarons, pastries, jams, and specialty teas. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a scenic urban rest stop, though it is a specialty destination rather than a practical resupply point for touring cyclists.
